notes: A bear simulator played as the animal itself is the Animal Sim preset in Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and that preset's wilderness-open shape is exactly what the author described: no settlement at all, just a large natural forest of trees, undergrowth and water for a creature to inhabit. Survival is named second because when asked what the bear does the author said the focus is surviving in the forest, but no threat, hunger or resource system was described, so nothing survival-specific is built beyond the den the bear returns to. Added water-body for the big rivers the author asked for twice, which is what puts CHECK on the route; the rivers read as surface water across one representable ground plane rather than a self-occluding volume, so this should clear the check. Dropped the preset's social-hub because the author describes controlling their own bear across a 2000-plus-stud forest and never mentions a gathering place, and I treated the day-night cycle and the third-person joystick controls as lighting and input rather than geometry, so neither reaches the layout.
